gates.name: word_count
gates.detail: 200 spoken words; need 180-225. Add about 2 words.

gates.name: hook_trigger
gates.detail: hook needs a number, a 'you', or a contradiction in the first line.

gates.name: hook_text
gates.detail: on-screen hook 'THE TIME FOR MONEY TRAP' should be 2-7 words.

gates.name: beat_length
gates.detail: beats too long for the ear: []

gates.name: visual_prompts
gates.detail: beats missing a concrete visual prompt: []

gates.name: loop_ending
gates.detail: end the last line mid-thought so it loops back into the hook.

gates.name: originality
gates.detail: too close to an earlier video (similarity 0.29); change the angle and hook.

gates.name: pillar_structure
gates.detail: an 'Escape the Rat Race' video must state the honest catch (effort, risk, or debt) and end with one concrete move for this week ('This week, ...').

gates.name: voice_quality
gates.detail: reads like generic AI copy (compression classifier): swap filler for concrete numbers, names, and short spoken sentences; cut phrases like 'financial journey' and 'unlock'

gates.name: readability
gates.detail: average sentence is 10.8 words; aim for 8-14.

gates.name: judge_hook
gates.detail: hook scored 7/10.
